_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: DoD Architecture Framework Documentation
summary: The DoD Architecture Framework Documentation DID captures architecture framework product documentation describing characteristics pertinent to the purpose of the architecture, used when comparing and relating architecture descriptions across organizational boundaries.
use_relationship:
The DoD Architecture Framework Documentation will be used to provide architecture framework product documentation that describes characteristics pertinent to the purpose of the architecture.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) is applicable when it is necessary to acquire architecture descriptions to compare and relate across organizational boundaries.
b. This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions of the architecture framework products as delineated in the contract Statement of Work (SOW).
c. This DID supersedes DI-MGMT-81644A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract SOW.

preparation_instructions.title: Content and Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Architecture Framework Product documentation shall be chosen per Table 1 according to the specific needs as stated in the contract SOW. The content and format shall be per Volume I, Introduction, Overview and Concepts, Volume II, Architectural Data and Model, of the DoD Architecture Framework Version, and Volume III, DoDAF Meta Model Physical Exchange Specification, current edition.
